subject: Sales → CS: NovusHealth deployment checkpoints & risk register
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Sales → CS: NovusHealth deployment checkpoints & risk register

Team —

Quick context: NovusHealth (primary contact Nicole Park) verbally committed to go-live for their pilot on Aug 2. Deal: RDW-2027-0584. They picked the hosted Dedicated tier with a VPC peering requirement and want log retention for 12 months. Value: $180k ARR annualized on a 12-month contract.

What I need from CS/Implementation to get this over the line this week:
- Confirm CS owner for activation and single point of contact for Novus (requested by procurement).
- Review attached MOP (operational playbook) and surface any non-starters (novus_mop_v1.xlsx).
- Validate required inputs for the kickoff (API keys, certs, expected throughput, security questionnaire).
- Identify any gating items that would push the go-live beyond Aug 2.

Notes / constraints from sales:
- Procurement expects signed SOW and DocuSign by Jul 5.
- Novus uses a VPC in us-west-2; they request peering + static IP egress.
- They run a compliance check that needs SOC-2 evidence and audit log retention policy.

Attachments: novus_mop_v1.xlsx (MOP draft), SOW_draft_v0.3.pdf (redline in progress).

Proposed next steps:
1) Internal sync today 10:30am PT to confirm owner and blockers.
2) Put a short risk register beside the MOP and share with procurement.

Assigning initial owner: assigning to CS lead — please confirm.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nicole Park <nicole.park@novushealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sales → CS: NovusHealth deployment checkpoints & risk register

Thanks Tessa — happy to take point on this.

I've skimmed the MOP and SOW draft. High-level callouts:
- Timeline: 6–8 week active implementation looks realistic given the VPC peering and cert exchange; for a pilot target of Aug 2 we should treat Aug 2 as an initial soft launch (limited users).
- Kickoff: propose Jul 7 for a 60-minute internal kickoff with Novus and our infra/SEs.
- Owners: Marissa (activation owner), Dev (SE pre-prod & cutover), Vivek (infra & peering), Tessa (exec sponsor).

Attaching a proposed kickoff agenda (kickoff-agenda.docx).

Action items for the internal sync:
- Dev: confirm peering runbook and estimated lead time for static egress IP allocation.
- Vivek: provide list of audit artifacts we can share immediately for procurement (SOC2 scope excerpt, retention policy).
- Tessa: please confirm procurement deadline and any mandatory SOW clauses.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-20T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sales → CS: NovusHealth deployment checkpoints & risk register

Looping in a few technical specifics after reviewing the MOP. See inline notes.

- Model & runtime: Novus requested a higher-quality Llama-derived variant; we should plan for the quantized FP16 variant (q4_2) to balance cost/latency. Expect ~350ms p95 on 4-token responses on Dedicated.
- VPC peering: lead time depends on customer's firewall SLA for route acceptance. Internal peering runbook requires a static egress IP for webhook callbacks; estimate 3 business days on our side once config approved.
- Data flows: confirm whether PHI or limited dataset will be sent. If yes, we must enforce encryption-in-flight and update the SOW accordingly.
- Test plan: recommend an early smoke test with 1k sample requests/day ramping to production patterns.

Attachment: architecture-sketch.png (network + routing stub).

Dev Patel
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Nicole Park <nicole.park@novushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Reynolds <sam.reynolds@novushealth.com>, procurement@novushealth.com
Date: 2027-06-21T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sales → CS: NovusHealth deployment checkpoints & risk register

Hi Marissa / Tessa —

Thanks for the summary. A few clarifications from our side before the kickoff:
- Procurement needs the final SOW and a short list of technical artifacts (SOC 2 report summary + log retention policy) by Jul 1 to proceed with legal sign-off.
- We can do Jul 7 for kickoff — appreciate the agenda.
- For the Aug 2 pilot we intend to run with a sample of 200 clinicians (non-PHI test data initially). If pilot looks good, we'll expand.
- Security questionnaire attached (security-questionnaire.pdf). Please confirm who at Redwood will own answers and a deadline for that.

Nicole Park
Director, Digital Product | NovusHealth
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@novushealth.com
Date: 2027-06-21T13:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sales → CS: NovusHealth deployment checkpoints & risk register

Adding implementation-level risks and mitigations to the register: 

1) Risk: VPC peering delays (customer firewall review).
   Mitigation: Pre-approve peering template and ask Novus network team for a dedicated review slot; plan for a VPN fallback for pilot.
   Owner: Vivek

2) Risk: SOW redlines on data residency / retention.
   Mitigation: Provide a short addendum with retention windows and mapping to log categories; aim to keep SOW generic and add appendices.
   Owner: Tessa + Legal (cc'd by procurement).

3) Risk: SOC2 evidence needed quickly.
   Mitigation: Share SOC2 summary and an excerpt of control mappings today; provide full report under NDA if requested.
   Owner: Marissa

4) Risk: Unexpected load causing model fallback.
   Mitigation: Configure autoscaling guardrails and a warm backup model (lower-cost variant) with automatic routing on overload.
   Owner: Dev

I can prepare the peering checklist and the artifact packet for procurement by EOD Jun 23. Also will include the estimated IP egress list.

Vivek Kulkarni
Implementation Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Nicole Park <nicole.park@novushealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sales → CS: NovusHealth deployment checkpoints & risk register

Appreciate the fast responses — summarizing decisions so we have a single canonical plan: 

- Activation owner: Marissa Cole (confirmed).
- Technical leads: Dev Patel (SE) and Vivek Kulkarni (Implementation).
- Procurement artifacts: Marissa to share SOC2 summary + retention policy by Jun 23.
- Kickoff: Jul 7, 11:00am PT — 60 min (goal: align on MOP, test plan, and cutover window).
- SOW: Tessa to push final SOW_draft_v0.3.pdf to DocuSign; legal redlines requested from Novus by Jul 5.
- Pilot scope: Aug 2 soft launch (limited users, non-PHI) — full production contingent on pilot results and procurement sign-off.

Open asks:
- Marissa: please add a short list of acceptance criteria to the kickoff agenda (smoke-test pass conditions).
- Dev: confirm whether the warm backup model (lower-cost variant) is configured by default or requires separate provisioning.
- Vivek: share the peering checklist and expected IP range by Jun 23.

I'll update the HubSpot deal with these owners/next steps and attach the MOP + risk register. DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/US-DocuSign-Link/abcdef123456

Thanks all —
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
